research_claim: In multi-hop RAG, the dominant failure is often an unbound query slot; binding a preceding answer restores candidate reachability. Remaining loss decomposes into candidate reachability and selection efficiency.

primary_causal_protocol.plan: same cached plan within each paired arm

primary_endpoint_protocol.ce: dataset-domain CE shared by methods within each dataset
primary_endpoint_protocol.reader: CoT/context-aware reader with decision-layer final selection
primary_endpoint_protocol.retrieval: dataset-specific final retrieval configuration; MuSiQue final configuration may use hybrid retrieval

diagnostic_protocol.selection_efficiency: 0.47-0.56 for pointwise selection; coverage selection near candidate ceiling

negative_results: query rewriting closes 9.5% of measured gap cases
LLM absolute sufficiency judgment is below base CE on the large real-gap evaluation
binding gates, consensus, rollback, lookahead, join variants and several matching-side signals did not yield a stable cross-dataset gain
answer-likelihood marginal utility fails on later hops
known_caveats: absolute endpoint numbers differ by reader, retriever, CE and stopping protocol; never mix rows without the protocol fields
the causal query-slot result uses gold-plan/controlled binding conditions as specified by the artifact
the reachability-selection decomposition is empirical and does not yet provide a parameterized bound
MuSiQue is the only dataset with the full per-hop causal labels
